summary: Completed iteration 2 testing of CRM Dashboard interactive features. All backend API filters work correctly. All KPI card clicks work. Product search functional. Minor UI overlay issue in product filter dropdown.

ui_bugs.issue: Overlay intercepts pointer events preventing clicks
ui_bugs.details: Fixed inset-0 z-40 div intercepts clicks when dropdown is open. Product search input works but selecting filtered results can be blocked by overlay.

passed_tests: Backend API: delivery_status_filter=__all_delivered__ returns 7907 delivered orders
Backend API: is_delayed=true returns 8 delayed orders correctly
Backend API: installation_filter=Pending returns 2 pending installation orders
Backend API: feedback_filter=Happy returns 459 happy feedback orders
Backend API: pagination works correctly (page=1, page=2) with different results
Frontend: Click Delayed KPI card opens 'Delayed Orders' panel with orders table
Frontend: Click In Transit KPI card opens 'In Transit Orders' panel
Frontend: Click Delivered KPI card opens 'Delivered Orders' panel
Frontend: Product filter has search input that accepts text filtering
Frontend: Order details panel close button works correctly
Frontend: Installation and Feedback chart elements are clickable and open details
Frontend: All required data-testid attributes present for interactive elements
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix product filter dropdown overlay issue - the fixed positioned overlay (z-40) is blocking clicks on dropdown options. Consider using force=true for clicks or adjusting z-index/positioning of overlay elements.

success_percentage.backend: 100% (30/30 API tests passed including all specific filter tests)
success_percentage.frontend: 95% (13/14 interactive features working, minor dropdown overlay issue)
